record.question: Which two nations reaffirmed a joint commitment to fight against terrorism on June 12, 2019?
record.explanation: Answer B: UAE and Germany. The dated UAE–Germany joint statement issued June 12, 2019 reaffirms their joint commitment to fight terrorism. Reference: https://www.mofa.gov.ae/en/MediaHub/News/2019/2019/6/12/12-06-2019-UAE-Germany-Statement. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
